approach: Static recompilation of the PPU code and the SPU jobs with ps3recomp, HLE system libraries, Direct3D 12 RSX backend
help: Frame rate reports from slower CPUs and 60 Hz monitors
notes: Work in progress: 0.1.0 to 0.4.0 are pre-releases, and the first full release will be 1.0.0. Needs your own copy of the game; no game data is stored in this repository. The game is built on the player's PC (Direct3D 12) and runs through the opening movie, the title screen, the menus and fights with sound; fights run at about 30 frames per second on the maintainer's PC, with drops in busy scenes on slower CPUs (see KNOWN_ISSUES.md). Online and Cross-Save upload need PSN and do nothing. Developed with AI agent assistance under the maintainers' direction.
